Start with the AI Career Guide

I created the guide to help you explore emerging AI roles and connect them to the skills you already have. Use it as a starting map, then choose a direction to investigate and practise.

Continue with the community

The free Anzolo Hope AI Fellowship community is a place to keep learning about practical adoption, exchange perspectives and build clarity. Request the guide to take the first step. For help accessing the community, contact me directly.

The request form asks for your name and email. The guide’s delivery and community access are handled outside this website; this site does not collect or store your form responses.
